headline: Taiwan stocks rise 1107 points this week, total market value of listed companies breaks NT$150 trillion again | Securities
summary: The TAIEX rose 1,107.16 points, or 2.45%, this week to close at 46,331.45. Total market value of listed companies reached NT$151.45 trillion, again above NT$150 trillion.
why: The TAIEX is Taiwan's main equity benchmark, and Taiwan's market is heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers that supply global technology supply chains.

impacts.name: TAIEX
impacts.why: The weekly gain and rising total market value directly reflect Taiwan's benchmark index move.
